This is a first-price sealed-bid auction with a second-price payment rule (Vickrey auction). In such auctions, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy, meaning it maximizes your expected profit regardless of what other bidders do. Since I want to maximize my profit in the long run, and this is the first round, I will bid my true value.
